newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH STATE 9-MTH TAX REVENUE UP 18.3 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH STATE 9-MTH TAX REVENUE UP 18.3 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The Finnish state's tax and tax-related revenues increased 18.3 percent year-on-year in January-September to 91.84 billion markka, the finance ministry said in a report dated November 11 and received on Tuesday.
State income and wealth tax revenue rose 28.8 percent to 32.07 billion while total income tax collected rose 11.3 percent to 91.84 billion markka.
Value-added tax revenue increased 19.0 percent to 32.22 billion markka and revenue from accise duties rose 6.2 percent to 17.45 billion markka.
In the first quarter, the state's tax and tax-related revenues rose 56.7 percent year-on-year, in Q2 the rise was 0.2 percent and in Q3 the increase was 5.7 percent, the ministry said.

In line with its earlier monthly reports, the ministry underlined that the steep increases in tax revenue stemmed from extrordinary factors, which had led to exceptionally low tax revenue figures last year.
State expenditure excluding debt amortisation fell 3.5 percent year-on-year to 155.82 billion markka.
The net borrowing requirement of the state finances fell by 28.8 billion markka year-on-year in January-September to 25.8 billion markka, the finance ministry said.
Net borrowing totalled 30.92 billion markka in January-September, down from 41.29 billion in the year-ago period.
